name: aside
description: Read-only side chat: /aside opens a pane beside the transcript where you ask about the session so far; answers come from a tool-less fork of the session's own transcript and nothing is written back into the main thread.

liveFallback.description: Until the session's first turn has completed there is no transcript snapshot to fork. On: answer such a question at once from the transcript text through a plain completion (uncached, capped at 60k characters, marked 'live' in the pane). Off: queue it and answer it with a fork when the turn ends.
liveFallback.title: Answer before the first turn completes

liveModel.description: Model alias or id for 'live' answers (a --model value); the fork always uses the session's model.
liveModel.title: Model for live answers

maxHistory.description: How many earlier side exchanges ride along in each question's prompt.
maxHistory.title: Side-chat history carried per question
